spiral.tale_zh: 五十音不是一张静态表，而是一条螺旋。你从「形」开始记住它，进入「词」听见它，走到「义」读懂它，探到「源」看穿它——然后回到第一旋，同一个音会露出新的深度。
spiral.tale_en: The gojūon is not a static chart but a spiral. You begin with the shape, hear the word, read the meaning, trace the origin — and when you return to the first ring, the same sound is deeper.

spiral.closure_zh: 看罢第四旋，请回到第一旋。你会发现：字形里藏着草书的呼吸，字音里站着季语的颜色。螺旋没有终点——回望即出发。
spiral.closure_en: Having walked the fourth ring, return to the first: the shapes now carry the breath of cursive script, the sounds the colour of season-words. The spiral has no end — looking back is setting out.

provenance.zh: 词例与文化注脚为教学创作 · AI 起草 · 待母语者审校；「典」为公认文化典故，「拟」为教学自造语。记 → 读 → 写三步之后，入正式语料前须走审校。
provenance.en: Words & cultural glosses are AI-drafted teaching lines pending native review; entries marked 典 are recognized cultural references, 拟 are teaching inventions.

word.zh: 回望「形」：你写下的每一个假名，在词里恰好占一拍——词不过是形的连缀。
word.en: Back to Shape: every kana you wrote takes exactly one mora inside a word — a word is shape strung together.

sense.zh: 回望「词」：同一个音，在季语里染上了颜色——词义是音与义的第一道分岔。
sense.en: Back to Word: the same sound takes on colour in a season-word — meaning is the first fork of sound.

root.zh: 回望「义」：字源解释了这份联想从何而来；草书的呼吸塑造了义的坐标。
root.en: Back to Sense: origin explains where the association came from; cursive breath shaped the coordinates of meaning.

law.zh: 回望「源」：音的来历与音的节律本是一体——源告诉你音从哪来，律告诉你音如何行走。
law.en: Back to Origin: where a sound comes from and how it moves are one — origin says whence, law says how.

shape.zh: 回望即出发——走到「律」，再回到「形」：每个假名已不再只是一个字，而是一拍、一个可升可降的音。
shape.en: Looking back is setting out — having reached Law, return to Shape: each kana is no longer just a letter, but one beat, one rising-and-falling tone.

mora.zh: 日语以「拍」（モーラ / mora）计时，而不是音节。一个假名 = 一拍；ん、っ、ー 也各占一整拍；拗音（きゃ）算一拍。所有拍子等长——这是日语听感的骨架。
mora.en: Japanese counts in morae, not syllables. One kana = one mora; ん, っ and ー each hold a full mora; a contracted sound (きゃ) counts as one. Every mora is about equally long — the skeleton of Japanese rhythm.

ex.zh: 大阪：3 个音节，4 拍

ex2.zh: 邮票：促音 っ 独占一拍
ex2.en: stamp: the っ holds a mora of its own

special.note_zh: 独占一拍，鼻音，没有自己的元音。
special.note_en: A full mora; a nasal with no vowel of its own.

special.note_zh: 一拍屏息，把后一个辅音「顶长」。きて→きって。
special.note_en: A mora of held silence that doubles the next consonant. kite → kitte.

special.note_zh: 一拍，把前一个元音拉长。おばさん→おばあさん。
special.note_en: A mora lengthening the preceding vowel. obasan → obaasan.

accent_intro.zh: 日语靠「高低」而非「强弱」。标准语（东京）里最关键的是「下がり目」——高音之后骤然下降的那一处；它落在哪一拍，词义就可能不同。
accent_intro.en: Japanese uses pitch, not stress. In standard (Tokyo) Japanese the key is the downstep — where a high pitch suddenly falls. Where it falls can change the word.
accent_intro.note_zh: 本页只讲「系统」；逐词的音调以权威辞典 / OJAD 为准，不在此臆断。
accent_intro.note_en: This page teaches the system only; per-word pitch follows an authoritative dictionary / OJAD, not guesswork.

accent_types.zh: 没有下降，后续助词仍高。
accent_types.en: No downstep; a following particle stays high.
High from the first mora, then falls.

accent_types.zh: 先升后降，下降落在词内。
accent_types.en: Rises then falls inside the word.

accent_types.zh: 词内全高，下降落在后续助词上。
accent_types.en: High through the word; the fall lands on the particle.

devoicing.zh: 母音无声化：i、u 夹在清辅音之间时常「只做口型、不发声」——です、ます、すき、きた。元音淡去，但拍数不变。
devoicing.en: Vowel devoicing: i and u between voiceless consonants are often whispered — desu, masu, suki, kita. The vowel fades, but the mora stays.

minimal_pairs.zh: 促音 っ 独占一拍。
minimal_pairs.en: The っ takes a mora of its own.
Same sounds, three meanings — separated by pitch alone.
